title: WAI-Session-Log.jsonl is always empty — conversation tracking never writes to it
summary: wai.md references WAI-Session-Log.jsonl as the conversation log path and closeout is supposed to truncate it at Step 6. File is consistently 0 lines across multiple sessions, suggesting no agent is ever writing turns to it. The field exists in WAI-State.json but is unused.
fix_suggestion: Either retire WAI-Session-Log.jsonl (replace with session track files which ARE being written) or define a clear write contract — which step/tool writes to it and in what format.
resolution: Already fixed in current codebase — verified session 101
